title: Shoe Obituaries
source: Original Adobe XD, 14 artboards; extracted in shoeobituaries-source-review.json
interpretation: Sentimental and lightly absurd shoe memorial. Original MoMo name, dates and rainstorm story retained. Burgundy sneaker, material palette and studio composition are visual interpretation, not a replica of the Nike Air Max in source text.

artwork.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-end landscape 3:2 concept artwork for "Shoe Obituaries", an actual 2018 silly-hackathon website for giving beloved worn-out shoes a send-off and sharing digital memorials. One cohesive finely crafted physical diorama, not panels or infographic.
Composition: three-quarter front view of a broad rounded warm ivory limestone plinth, dark desaturated sage studio backdrop. Left/centre hero: one beautifully detailed worn burgundy and ivory low-top sneaker named MoMo resting inside an open small walnut shoebox coffin lined with cream fabric. Toe points toward viewer-left; realistic layered rubber sole, lace eyelets, loosely criss-crossed ivory laces, stitched burgundy suede panels, cracked and scuffed toe rubber, discreet fraying. No brand logo. A matching hinged walnut lid stands open behind at about 100 degrees, with a small engraved brass nameplate "MoMo". This is affectionate humour for a SHOE, no human funerals.
Right: a slightly angled portrait tablet in a slim aged-brass frame, physically supported, showing a clean editorial cream-and-charcoal digital obituary. Exact readable text: "Shoe Obituaries", "In loving memory", "MoMo", "2010 — 2018", "Every step, remembered.", "Share tribute". A small monochrome illustration of the same sneaker in the obituary. Elegant serif typography, spacious layout, no other tiny text.
Foreground left one long-stem white rose laid diagonally beside the shoebox, finely layered petals and sage leaves. Foreground right a paper memory card with elegant writing strokes and a brass fountain pen, hinting at writing the shoe's story. Small brass path inlaid into base links physical shoe and tablet. Subtle tiny shoeprints engraved into the limestone. Front base plaque "Shoe Obituaries". No graveyard, no crosses, no skulls, no smoke, no ghost, no halos, no people, no additional shoes.
Materials: deeply figured oiled walnut grain, realistic fabric weave, worn suede, rubber tread grooves, detailed laces, satin brass, hand-finished limestone. Warm soft key light, gentle cool rim, cinematic contact shadows, high-quality macro product photography, entire diorama crisp with all objects comfortably inside frame. Quietly witty, tender, tactile, sophisticated. Buildable composition with obvious physical geometry that can be recreated as an animated 3D model. Image only.

animation: 32-second deterministic sequence: inspect shoe, write backstory, close wood coffin and place rose, share digital tribute; manual controls play and hold a complete stage.
verification: 2 tests pass; 208,096 triangles; deterministic 32-second sequence and manual seeking. Desktop artwork and 3D visually checked; no captured browser errors or warnings. Astro check: 0 errors and 0 warnings; 97 pages built.
